# CoachIn1

> CoachIn1 is a marketplace for training and nutrition plans from independent coaches, by Micro Macro Nutri Labs (Germany).

Coaches sell training plans (strength and cardio sessions with exercise pictures), nutrition plans (meals with calories and macros) and monthly coaching. Buyers follow the plan in the app, log every set (kg or lb), track body weight and progress photos, chat with the coach, and leave reviews with optional before and after photos. Data is stored in the EU (Ireland).

- Availability: web app at https://app.coachin1.com (nothing to install). The iPhone and Android apps get the marketplace with their next update.
- Buying: prices are set by the coach, €2.99–€199.99 one-off or €4.99–€199.99 a month for coaching, VAT included. Paid through the App Store or Google Play in the apps, and through Paddle (Merchant of Record) on the web. One-off plans stay in the buyer's account; monthly coaching runs until cancelled.
- Selling: free, no monthly fee. From each sale, after VAT and the store's fee (15% App Store / Google Play, 5% + €0.50 Paddle), CoachIn1 keeps 20% when the buyer came through the coach's own link and 30% when the buyer found the coach on CoachIn1. Coaches are paid monthly by bank transfer with a self-billing statement. Plans can be imported from Excel or CSV.
- Website: https://coachin1.com/ (also in German: https://coachin1.com/de/, Czech: https://coachin1.com/cs/, Slovak: https://coachin1.com/sk/). Fees: https://coachin1.com/#pricing
- Terms for buyers: https://app.coachin1.com/legal/buyer-terms
- Terms for coaches: https://app.coachin1.com/legal/seller-terms
- Privacy Policy: https://coachin1.com/privacy-policy.html
- Terms of Use: https://coachin1.com/terms.html
- Account deletion: https://coachin1.com/account-deletion.html
- Contact: info@coachin1.com
